plainTranslation: The Moon person can support the Sun person's direction, and the Sun person can give the Moon person a clear place to respond from. The warmth is available, but it wants small choices: checking in, noticing moods, and making room for both identity and need.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The problem is leaving it half-open. The compatibility is there, but it may stay kind of mild if both people wait for the other one to make it more real.
advice: Make the effort. Not a grand gesture, just enough to show the connection matters.
